headlines.title: Robinhood Sinks 10%, SoFi Down 8% as Bitcoin Slides and Fintech Stocks Sell Off
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysRobinhood shares fell 10% today in a crypto-led selloff, pulling SoFi, Block and PayPal lower too. Robinhood fell harder than PayPal and Block because most of its revenue still comes from customers’ trading.

headlines.title: Robinhood Sinks 12%, SoFi Tumbles 9%, Affirm Drops 8% as Bitcoin Slides and Democratic Congress Weighs on Fintech
headlines.summary: Crypto is bleeding and a new Congress is circling, but the sharpest fintech selloff is not hitting every name equally. Why are PayPal and Block holding up while the growth darlings take the heat, and who in Washington is setting the stakes?

headlines.title: American Express vs. PayPal: Which Financial Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
headlines.summary: American Express commands premium margins and a closed-loop advantage, while PayPal trades at a significant valuation discount despite stronger profitability metrics.

headlines.title: New PayPal Data: Gaming and Fashion From Singapore Drive International Consumer Demand
headlines.summary: Ahead of the year-end shopping season, new PayPal data highlights the international purchase behaviour influencing consumer demand from Singapore businesses. The findings point to opportunities across both established markets such as the United States and Germany, as well as fast-growing demand from online shoppers in Mexico and Vietnam, reflecting increasingly diverse patterns of global commerce.

headlines.title: Freedom Broker cuts PayPal to Hold as branded checkout stalls
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Freedom Broker downgraded PayPal to Hold from Buy and cut its price target to $63 from $72 in a note Wednesday, saying the payments company’s branded checkout business has failed to reaccelerate.

description: PayPal Holdings, Inc. operates a technology platform that enables digital payments for merchants and consumers worldwide. The company operates a two-sided network at scale that connects merchants and consumers that enables its customers to connect, transact, and send and receive payments through online and in person, as well as transfer and withdraw funds using various funding sources, such as bank accounts, PayPal or Venmo account balance, consumer credit and debit products, credit and debit cards, and cryptocurrencies, as well as other stored value products, including gift cards and eligible rewards. It provides payment solutions under the PayPal, PayPal Credit, Braintree, Venmo, Xoom, Hyperwallet, Honey, and Paidy names. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
